no_adcom_quote.quote: An advisory committee was not convened for this application. After initial review of the data the Agency decided that the efficacy and safety were sufficiently clear and did not raise significant public health questions on the role of the drug in the diagnosis, cure, mitigation, treatment, or prevention of a disease, and there were no controversial issues that would have benefited from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for SURFAXIN (NDA021746). The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Office Director memo, and Medical Review all state consistently that no AdComm was held because the efficacy and safety data were sufficiently clear and raised no significant public health questions or controversial issues warranting outside expert discussion. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
